adopted.hypothesis: A Babylon high-texture decode/upload callback can remain unresolved after the separately bounded resource/cache download. Its permanent highTexturePending=1 then prevents VillageGeometryStreaming.update from admitting any missing geometry tier.
sourceEvidence: VillageTextureStreaming.loadTexture originally had success/error/dispose settlement but no timer or deadline.
VillageTextureStreaming.start reserves bytes and sets highTexturePending until its load promise finally settles.
VillageGeometryStreaming.update returns early while stats.highTexturePending is set.
ResourceDownloads.run already bounds fetch/cache waits with the existing MapLoadLifetime; that lifetime does not bound the later Babylon Texture callback.
adopted.change: Reuse MapLoadLifetime with the existing MAP_MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS=45000 for each admitted high Texture callback. Check the logical deadline again before accepting completion; close and detach it on success, error, map disposal or timeout. Timeout follows the existing failure/no-auto-retry policy and releases only the owned wrapper through releaseMapTexture.
qualityAndScheduling: No texture dimensions, codecs, sampling, gamma/sRGB settings, byte budgets, admission dwell, motion pacing or selected geometry tiers changed.
The resource download progress deadline remains independent; a healthy large startup/player download is not capped by this new callback deadline.
No parallel upload, replacement scheduler, automatic retry, material reassignment or visibility change is added.
One existing serial upload is the upper bound on simultaneous added deadline timers.

ownership.finalOwner: releaseMapTexture marks only the exact final-owner InternalTexture abandoned, removes its cache/pending token, and disposes its Texture wrapper.
ownership.sharedOwner: With another live Texture reference, only this wrapper is disposed. The shared InternalTexture remains cached/pending until its real completion, and the other caller can finish normally.
ownership.lateResults: A timed-out callback cannot settle twice, install a resident, modify an old material, or overwrite a fresh stream's diagnostics/material.
ownership.limitation: A logical deadline does not interrupt synchronous WASM/driver execution. The existing KTX abandonment guard can suppress a later upload of an abandoned final-owner allocation; this change makes no claim that already-running GPU/driver work is interrupted.

cases: At44999ms the reservation remains live; at45000ms missing callback clears pending/reserved/waiters/pending-scene token, retains base texture and allows the exact same deferred level2 geometry request.
A second live Texture retains the same shared InternalTexture, one reference, cache entry and pending token after timeout; real completion makes it ready.
Late old success/error callbacks after timeout cannot replace a fresh completed4K material or alter its diagnostics.
A completion queued beyond the logical deadline is rejected before timer dispatch and disposes its wrapper exactly once.
Success, error and map disposal remove callback timers/listeners; existing no-auto-retry and quiet cancellation semantics remain.
